summary.headline: Part of Fortune in the Houses
summary.text: Interpretation of the Part of Fortune in the fourth through eighth houses: prosperity in dealings with parents, estates, mines, children, servants, livestock, women, migration, and trade, but loss and greatest misfortune when placed in the eighth house or opposed from the second.
